messages.content: Give me the detail of the exhibition named 'Wonder of Nature' in the Louvre museum, and 'Age of Reptiles' in the British Museum. Plus their cost per visit for children and adult.

function.name: museum_exhibition_detail
function.description: Provides details of a particular exhibition in a museum, including the cost per visit for different age groups. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

visitor_type.description: Age group of the visitor. Default is: ['adult']

We need to call the function twice? Actually we can combine into one request but likely separate calls.

The user wants details of two exhibitions:

1) Wonder of Nature at Louvre museum
2) Age of Reptiles at British Museum

Also want cost per visit for children and adults.

So we should use the function `museum_exhibition_detail` with appropriate parameters.

But note that the function signature expects only one set of arguments; it returns details about an exhibition. We might have to make two calls or maybe pass multiple names? But spec says single exhibition_name param. So do two calls.

Thus produce output after calling each function separately. We'll first call for Wonder of Nature (Louvre). Then for Age of Reptiles (British Museum).

We'll include both child and adult costs. For default visitor type is adult if not specified. To get child price, specify visitor_type="child". Also adult price via default or specifying "adult".

Better to call once for each combination? Could call twice per exhibition: one for adult, one for child. That would be four calls total. Or could ask function to return all info? It doesn't support returning both ages simultaneously unless you provide array ["adult","child"] as visitor_type. Yes, visitor_type accepts array of strings. So we can supply ["adult", "child"]. That will give us data for both categories presumably.

Let's assume function supports array input. Provide visitor_type:["adult","child"]

Ok let's proceed.

First call: museum_exhibition_detail({"exhibition_name":"Wonder of Nature","museum_name":"Louvre","visitor_type":["adult","child"]})

Second call: same pattern for other.
